title: Store — Live floor
description: Is my store OK right now and how is today going: open orders, today's numbers, and whether the Pi, printers, tablets and POS link are up.

list.name: pg
list.label: Store database
list.description: Follows env: pg-prod / pg-staging (no Postgres datasource for dev).

list.name: store
list.label: Store
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT tenant AS __value, store_name AS __text FROM reporting.stores ORDER BY 2
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tenant AS __value, store_name AS __text FROM reporting.stores ORDER BY 2

panels.title: Right now — what is on the floor
Waiting to accept
panels.description: Orders (online + POS) that arrived and nobody has accepted on the tablet yet. Should be back to 0 within a minute — if red, the tablet is not ringing or nobody hears it: check the counter tablet.

panels.title: Cooking
panels.description: Accepted orders in the kitchen (not marked ready yet). Context, not an alarm — compare with Late now.

panels.title: Ready, waiting
panels.description: Orders marked ready that are not picked up / sent out yet. If red, food is sitting: send drivers out or call pickup customers.

panels.title: Out on delivery
panels.description: Delivery orders currently with a driver. Context for the driver count — no threshold.

panels.title: Late now
panels.description: Online orders still cooking past the ready time promised at accept. If red, the kitchen is behind: tell the customer or re-promise.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "late" FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND received_at > now() - interval '30 hours' AND business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected') AND late AND ready_at IS NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Scheduled (future)
panels.description: Orders placed for later that are not due in the kitchen yet. Context only.

panels.title: Today so far (online orders, store's local day)
Orders
panels.description: Online orders today (cancelled excluded), and the change vs the same weekday last week up to this time. A big red drop on a normal day: check the pipeline dashboard — orders may not be arriving.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date) AS "orders",
  100.0 * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date)
           - count(*) FILTER (WHERE business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date - 7
                              AND (received_at AT TIME ZONE timezone)::time <= (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::time))
    / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date - 7
                              AND (received_at AT TIME ZONE timezone)::time <= (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::time), 0) AS "vs last week"
FROM reporting.orders
WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND received_at > now() - interval '9 days' AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')

panels.title: Sales
panels.description: Order totals today (what customers paid: incl. tax, fees and tip; cancelled excluded), and the change vs the same weekday last week up to this time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  sum(total_cents) FILTER (WHERE business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date) / 100.0 AS "sales",
  100.0 * (coalesce(sum(total_cents) FILTER (WHERE business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date), 0)
           - sum(total_cents) FILTER (WHERE business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date - 7
                                      AND (received_at AT TIME ZONE timezone)::time <= (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::time))
    / NULLIF(sum(total_cents) FILTER (WHERE business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date - 7
                                      AND (received_at AT TIME ZONE timezone)::time <= (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::time), 0) AS "vs last week"
FROM reporting.orders
WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND received_at > now() - interval '9 days' AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')

panels.title: Average ticket
panels.description: Average order total today. Context for sales — a sudden drop can mean items or modifiers are missing from the menu.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(total_cents) / 100.0 AS "avg ticket" FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND received_at > now() - interval '30 hours' AND business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')

panels.title: Median accept time
panels.description: Half of today's orders were accepted faster than this (arrival → accept on the tablet). Yellow over 1 min, red over 2 min (when the Pi starts paging): someone needs to watch the tablet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY accept_seconds) AS "accept" FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND received_at > now() - interval '30 hours' AND business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date AND accept_seconds IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Prep: promised → actual
panels.description: Median prep time promised at accept vs the median actual (accept → ready) today. Actual well above promised means the promise is too short for the current rush: promise longer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY prep_minutes_promised) AS "promised",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY prep_minutes_actual) AS "actual"
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND received_at > now() - interval '30 hours' AND business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected')

panels.title: Ready on time
panels.description: Share of today's orders that were ready by the promised time (still-cooking late orders count as late). Red under 80 %: promise longer prep times or add kitchen help.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT late)
       / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE ready_at IS NOT NULL OR late), 0) AS "on time"
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND received_at > now() - interval '30 hours' AND business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected') AND estimated_ready_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Delivery round trip
panels.description: Median minutes from a delivery leaving with the driver to being marked delivered, today. Yellow over 35, red over 50: runs are too long — check bundling/AUTO plans or driver count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_minutes) AS "round trip" FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND received_at > now() - interval '30 hours' AND business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date AND fulfillment_type = 'delivery' AND delivery_minutes IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Cancelled
panels.description: Online orders cancelled today. Red at 3+: look at the cancelled orders on Trends — a pattern (one item, one time) usually has a cause.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "cancelled" FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND received_at > now() - interval '30 hours' AND business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date AND (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'cancelled')

panels.title: Store health — can orders reach the kitchen?
Pi online
panels.description: Whether the store's Pi has reported in the last 5 minutes (with several stores selected: how many are reporting). OFFLINE = online orders cannot ring or print: power-cycle the Pi, then see Pi & printers.

targets.expr: count(max by (tenant) ({__name__=~"agent_disk_free(_bytes)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Printers
panels.description: Each kitchen/receipt printer as last probed by the Pi. DOWN = tickets reroute to another printer (REROUTED banner): check the printer's power, paper and network cable.

panels.title: Tablets connected
panels.description: Paired Quibase tablets currently listening to the Pi. 0 = nothing will ring for a new order: wake/restart the counter tablet and check Wi-Fi.

panels.title: POS link
panels.description: Whether the in-store hub can reach the SoftTouch POS (Lombardi's). DOWN = POS orders stop appearing on the tablet: check the store box running quicc-hub and the POS server.

panels.title: POS last heard
panels.description: Seconds since the hub last reported to the Pi. Red over 5 min: the hub is stuck or off even if the link last said UP.

panels.title: Orders not reaching the Pi
panels.description: Orders main has but the Pi has not acknowledged for over a minute. Should always be 0 — red means an order may not be on the floor: check the Pi and the tablet now.

panels.title: Changes not synced
panels.description: Floor changes (accepts, ready, drivers) the Pi has not pushed to the cloud yet. The floor keeps working; above 0 for long means the store's internet is down and online status/tracking is stale.

panels.title: Orders on the floor
panels.description: Open orders on the Pi by state (online + POS). A growing 'new' band means orders ring unanswered; a growing 'ready' band means food is waiting for drivers or customers.

panels.title: Orders arriving (per 15 min)
panels.description: Online orders received per 15 minutes, by order type. Shows the rush; a flat zero during open hours means orders are not arriving — check the pipeline.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(received_at, '15m'), fulfillment_type AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM reporting.orders WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Time to accept (rolling 30 min)
panels.description: How long orders wait for someone to accept them on the tablet (p50 / p90, online and POS). p90 climbing past 2 min means orders are ringing unattended.

panels.title: Open orders now
panels.description: Every online order not finished yet, oldest first. 'Due in' is minutes until the promised ready time — red means it is already late. Click an order id for its logs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT kitchen_order_number AS "#",
       store_name AS "store",
       fulfillment_type AS "type",
       CASE WHEN status IN ('received','validated') THEN 'NEW'
            WHEN status = 'scheduled' THEN 'SCHEDULED'
            WHEN status IN ('accepted','preparing') THEN 'COOKING'
            WHEN status = 'ready' THEN 'READY'
            WHEN status = 'on_delivery' THEN 'OUT'
            ELSE upper(status) END AS "state",
       round((extract(epoch FROM now() - received_at) / 60)::numeric, 0) AS "age",
       round(prep_minutes_promised::numeric, 0) AS "prep promised",
       CASE WHEN ready_at IS NULL AND estimated_ready_at IS NOT NULL
            THEN round((extract(epoch FROM estimated_ready_at - now()) / 60)::numeric, 0) END AS "due in",
       driver_name AS "driver",
       order_id::text AS "order id"
FROM reporting.orders
WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND received_at > now() - interval '30 hours' AND business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled','rejected') AND status IN ('received','validated','scheduled','accepted','preparing','ready','on_delivery')
ORDER BY received_at ASC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Today's orders
panels.description: Every online order today with its stage times. Red cells are the slow part of that order (accept over 2 min, prep over promise, delivery over 50 min) — that is where to look when a customer complains.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT received_at AS "received",
       kitchen_order_number AS "#",
       store_name AS "store",
       fulfillment_type AS "type",
       status,
       round(accept_seconds::numeric, 0) AS "accept",
       round(prep_minutes_promised::numeric, 0) AS "prep promised",
       round(prep_minutes_actual::numeric, 0) AS "prep actual",
       round((prep_minutes_actual - prep_minutes_promised)::numeric, 0) AS "prep over",
       round(wait_out_minutes::numeric, 0) AS "driver wait",
       round(delivery_minutes::numeric, 0) AS "delivery",
       round(total_minutes::numeric, 0) AS "total time",
       late,
       driver_name AS "driver",
       total_cents / 100.0 AS "total",
       order_id::text AS "order id"
FROM reporting.orders
WHERE tenant IN (${store:sqlstring}) AND received_at > now() - interval '30 hours' AND business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date
ORDER BY received_at DESC
LIMIT 500
